checkpoint_storage.archive_qualification: Selected inference archives contain trained network weights and fresh ancillary Adadelta state (iteration zero, all 24 slot arrays zero). Inference loads compile=False. They are not resumable training snapshots; original bytes must remain unchanged.
checkpoint_storage.verification_required: Remote LFS resolution alone is insufficient: fresh download all 18 object bodies and verify byte count plus SHA-256 against these frozen originals.
checkpoint_storage.quota_policy: Check installed/configured LFS and known blockers before upload. Stop on remote quota/storage rejection; do not silently omit or modify checkpoint archives.
